A1.justification: Both PDFs are complete 23-page versions of the same study, with matching Sections 1–6 and Appendices A–E. Their text, equations, tables, and figures support reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original embedding-scaling experiments across ten recommendation datasets, plus BPR denoising and dropping-ratio experiments in Figures 3 and 7.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results, including the benchmark scaling curves and appendix dropping-ratio analysis.

M1.justification: The model formulations and loss-based sample-dropping procedure remain unchanged. Equation 4 and the BPR_Drop implementation in Appendix D.2 specify the same algorithm.

E1.justification: Table 3 retains the same ten datasets: ML-100K, ML-1M, Modcloth, Douban, Pinterest, Yelp, Gowalla, and Amazon Baby, Beauty, and Books. The scaling and denoising scenarios are unchanged.

E2.justification: The corresponding plots retain the same BPR, NeuMF, LightGCN, and SGL participation, including the three-model ML-1M comparison. Figures 3 and 7 retain the same BPR versus BPR_Drop comparisons.

E3.justification: Appendix D.1 retains NDCG@20, the powers-of-two embedding sweep, 300 training epochs, batch size 2,048, Adam settings, uniform negative sampling, and ten-epoch early stopping. No evaluation procedure is revised.

E4.justification: Figures 3 and 7 retain the same denoising intervention and save-ratio sensitivity analysis on ML-100K and Douban. Appendix E.2 preserves the same ratios and analysis; no ablation or robustness study is added or removed.

E5.justification: Neither version reports empirical seed counts, repeated-run counts, confidence intervals, error bars, or significance tests. The uncertainty-reporting practice is unchanged.

E6.justification: All 44 embedded plot images match exactly and occur in the same sequence. Numerical findings, including the 25.57% and 34.36% statements in Section 3.2, are unchanged; no result entries are added or removed.

T1.justification: The definitions, lemmas, theorems, corollaries, and Appendix C proofs retain the same mathematical substance. Section 2 corrects user/item index labels without changing a definition or derivation.

C1.justification: Both versions claim discovery of double-peak and logarithmic scaling, attribute scaling difficulties to interaction noise, and present denoising and theoretical robustness analysis as supporting contributions.

C2.justification: The four-stage noise/overfitting interpretation, graph-convolution and contrastive-learning explanations, and Appendix E interpretations are retained. Section 6 preserves the limitations concerning model coverage and evaluation primarily at K=20.

D1.justification: The RecBole reference, eight 80 GB GPU setup, hyperparameters, dataset statistics, and Appendix D.2 code are unchanged. The code listing is reformatted without changing its implementation or access information.

R1.justification: The cited works and research positioning remain unchanged, including Appendix B's scaling, efficiency, and denoising discussions. Citation punctuation and typography change, but no work is added or removed.

P1.justification: v2 corrects several grammatical and index-label errors and changes citation formatting. The first-author name changes from Zhuangzhuang He to Yicheng He, with expanded affiliations and contact details; the section order and substantive prose remain stable.

P2.justification: Document-wide retypesetting changes fonts, margins, headings, the author block, and figure/table sizes and placement. Existing plots are enlarged, Tables 2–3 move to page 20, Figure 6 moves to page 23, and the code listing spans two pages. Displayed scientific content is retained.

improvement.justification: The revision primarily changes presentation. Larger plots and small grammatical/index corrections offer modest readability benefits, while reflow splits the previously single-page code listing. Both versions remain readable and contain equivalent arguments, evidence, proofs, and reproducibility information, leaving overall quality essentially unchanged.
